taskTemplates.name: Murphy Unit {{item}}
taskTemplates.action: Study Unit {{item}}: read the explanation, do the exercises, write 3 true personal examples, then say them aloud.

taskTemplates.name: Current grammar — 3 personal sentences
taskTemplates.action: Close the book and make 3 true sentences using this week's grammar.

taskTemplates.name: {{value}}
taskTemplates.action: Practice {{value}}. Listen first, repeat, then record yourself if possible.

taskTemplates.name: Pronunciation quick review
taskTemplates.action: Recall and pronounce 5 words/sounds from this week before checking your notes.

taskTemplates.name: {{item}} — cold attempt
taskTemplates.action: Speak about “{{item}}” without a script. Keep going for 1 minute and note only the biggest gaps.

taskTemplates.name: {{item}} — improved answer
taskTemplates.action: Speak again about “{{item}}” for 1–2 minutes with clearer structure, 5 useful chunks and at least one reason/example.

taskTemplates.name: {{value}}
taskTemplates.action: Listen once without transcript, answer/check, then identify why you missed anything. Extract at most 3 useful items.

taskTemplates.name: Shadow 5 useful lines
taskTemplates.action: Repeat 5 short lines after the audio and copy rhythm, stress and linking.

taskTemplates.name: {{value}}
taskTemplates.action: Do this week's reading focus: {{value}}. Do not stop for every unknown word.

taskTemplates.name: Reading mistake review
taskTemplates.action: Review wrong answers and write one short reason for each error. Keep at most 3 useful language items.

taskTemplates.name: {{value}}
taskTemplates.action: Write: {{value}}. Prioritize clear, accurate sentences. After correction, rewrite the weakest 3 sentences.

taskTemplates.name: IELTS class — pre-class review
taskTemplates.action: Review the previous class's most important corrections and re-say 1–2 corrected answers.

taskTemplates.name: IELTS class — post-class corrections
taskTemplates.action: After class, save only important grammar, pronunciation and useful-expression corrections. Then re-answer one corrected question.

taskTemplates.name: Weekly review — top 10 items
taskTemplates.action: Recall the 10 highest-value expressions/errors from this week. Say a personal example for each item you still find difficult.
